evals.name: personal-site-biotech-ai
evals.prompt: /uri-one-click-site "Personal site for Uri Yablonka, a senior biotech officer and board member who writes about agentic AI in biopharma. Home, about, articles, contact. Keep the existing copy from the current pages." --into site-v2
evals.expected_output: A multi-page static site in <workspace>/builds/<name>/ copied to site-v2/: scroll-craft landing page, About/Articles/Contact built on the same tokens, PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md at the project root, lab/ strips, a report listing assumptions and placeholders, no fabricated credentials or metrics.
expectations: index.html exists in the outputs and renders in Chrome at 1440 and 390 wide with no horizontal overflow and no page errors
The page has exactly one h1, a lang attribute, a title of 10-70 characters, a meta description of 50-160 characters and a viewport meta
No em dash appears in visible text
No scroll-cue text and no zero-padded section counters appear in visible text
No lorem ipsum, TODO, FIXME or bracketed placeholder text remains in visible copy
Every img element has an alt attribute
Impeccable's detector reports zero low-contrast warnings on the page files
The CSS contains no 'transition: all' and no gradient text (background-clip: text)
The CSS honours prefers-reduced-motion
Visible copy contains no invented numbers: no currency amounts, percentages or year-like dates
The canvas is not pure black: no background set to #000 or #000000
Screenshots exist for a desktop width (>=1200px) and a mobile width (<=800px, i.e. 390 at 2x)
report.md lists the run's assumptions and its placeholders
The h1 heading text is present statically in index.html (real markup, not runtime-injected)
privacy.html, terms.html and accessibility.html exist and every page's footer links all three
Every page's footer carries a copyright line with the current year
axe-core reports zero serious or critical WCAG 2.2 AA violations on every page at 1440 and 390 px
Every keyboard tab stop shows a visible focus change; no keyboard trap
No horizontal overflow at 320 px, including with the WCAG text-spacing override
The privacy policy names every third-party host, cookie and form field found in lab/data-inventory.json
No accessibility overlay widget is present
The report lists legal launch blockers and recommends review by counsel
